entry_rule: After 10:30, first complete 15-minute close strictly above opening-range high (long) or below opening-range low (short); at most one signal per symbol per session
stop_rule: Structural stop at the opposite opening-range boundary
exit_rule: 15:45 America/New_York; on early-close sessions use 15 minutes before the exchange close
funding: Use cached realized funding only; no funding estimate uses future values
limitations: Historical exchange filters and contract fee tier are approximations
No historical order book or executable fills
Do not treat equity stock bars as these perpetual contracts
